title: Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb stew inspired by Algerian cuisine, adapted with a German twist.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high.
Brown the lamb in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the spice blend, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with any accumulated juices.
Add enough water to cover the lamb and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
